points.title: It isn’t/wasn’t until... + that + S + V.... (“直到...才...”的強調句型)
examples: In Korea, it is not until the elderly take the first bite that youngsters can start eating.
It isn’t until the bell rings that we can leave the classroom.
It wasn’t until the river was seriously polluted that the government started to pay attention to the problem.
It was not until Edward plucked up the courage to apologize to his mother that she forgave him.

points.title: ...either...or.... (不是...就是...; 二者擇一)/...neither...nor.... (不是...也不是...；二者都不)；對等連接詞，動詞採「就近原則」
examples: You can have either fish or pork. It’s your choice.
I want neither fish nor beef. I’m a vegetarian.
Neither obstacles nor failures should stop us from moving forward.
Either you or the teacher is wrong.
Neither the students nor Tom likes the movie.
